title: BFK Podcast: Single-A Private Preseason Preview - Bayside, Cottage Hill, and Mobile Christian Lead the Race
text:
The Big Friday Kickoff Podcast dives into the 2026 Single-A Private classification with a deep preview of the eight-team region. Hosts Emily Cochran and Robert Ristaneo analyze the key contenders - including defending champion Bayside Academy, Cottage Hill Christian, and Mobile Christian - while highlighting the emerging talent and competitive landscape for the upcoming season.
) - The Big Friday Kickoff Podcast continues its 2026 preseason region previews with a look at the new Single-A Private classification. Sports Director Emily Cochran and Robert Ristaneo go school by school through the eight-team region, led by defending region champion Bayside Academy, Cottage Hill Christian and Mobile Christian.
They break down the quarterback battle between Bayside junior Davis Barnett and Cottage Hill junior Shamar Toodle, why Emily believes Mobile Christian is a team to watch, the race for the remaining playoff spots and the challenges facing the classification’s newest programs.
